name: N.W.A
hook: The Compton group that put West Coast street reporting at the centre of rap, drew a letter from the FBI, and built 'Straight Outta Compton' on the Amen break.
blurb: N.W.A came together in Compton, California, in 1986: Eazy-E, Dr. Dre, Ice Cube, MC Ren, DJ Yella and others. Eazy-E paid for it through his label, Ruthless Records. Their 1988 album Straight Outta Compton described life in their neighbourhood, including police harassment, in blunt language, and made West Coast gangsta rap a national force. The FBI wrote a letter to their record company complaining about 'Fuck tha Police', a rare direct collision between the government and a record. The title track is built on the Amen break. Ice Cube left in 1989 in a dispute over money, and the group ended in 1991. Eazy-E died of AIDS in 1995. Dr. Dre, the group's main producer, pleaded no contest in 1991 to assaulting the television host Dee Barnes and was sentenced to probation, and a related civil suit was settled. He has since admitted the assault. That is part of the record here. His production after N.W.A, G-funk and 'The Chronic', is covered at his own entry (`dr-dre`).
